questions.explanation:
Polar molecular solids are formed by molecules that have polar covalent bonds and possess a net dipole moment. A net dipole moment arises when there is an asymmetric distribution of charge in the molecule, resulting in a separation of positive and negative charges.

Out of the given options, only option C consists of two polar molecular solids - and . has polar covalent bonds due to the difference in electronegativity between sulfur and oxygen, and the molecule has a net dipole moment due to its bent molecular geometry. Similarly, has polar covalent bonds due to the difference in electronegativity between nitrogen and hydrogen, and the molecule has a net dipole moment due to its trigonal pyramidal molecular geometry.

Therefore, the correct answer is - .
